description: ScoreLUT head, tph=128 (full backbone) version of exp542. residual LUTs emit score space m*k=16*64=1024 (n_outputs=1024, tph=128 -> residual_lut ~50M, model ~120M). logits produced DIRECTLY via per-token gather over the score table (logit(v)=sum_j w_v[j]*S[j,code_v[j]]), no D-readout matmul; codes learned via query-latent<->slot-key soft-assign, argmax-gather at deploy. Dual eval soft+hard. exp542 (tph=16) was starved (3.03@400); this gives the backbone full tables. vs exp513 Linear 1.4825/1.4656 (89M); this ~120M but matmul-free 4.75M head vs 12.6M Linear.
